description: This PHP file defines the 'Skill' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping the class to the 'ohrm_skill' database table using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for skill ID, name, description, and associated employee skills, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: An entity class representing a skill within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for ID, name, description, and associated employee skills, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the skill.

methods.description: Sets the ID of the skill.
